newsitem.title: USA: Sprint to transfer Kansas exchange assets.
newsitem.headline: Sprint to transfer Kansas exchange assets.

text.p: Rural Telephone Service Co Inc said Tuesday it, along with Sprint Corp and Golden Belt Telephone signed a definitive agreement to transfer ownership of four telephone exchanges in western Kansas.

Local exchanges of Hill City, Quinter and WaKeeney will be acquired by Rural Telephone, while Golden Belt will buy the Ellis local exchange, the three companies said in a joint statement. Financial terms were not disclosed.

The transfer of ownership is contingent upon the companies obtaining regulatory approval, although Rural and Golden Belt are expected to take over maintenance responsibilities by mid-March, the companies said.
Its shares closed down 5/8 Tuesday at 44-1/2.
